sentences.en: It’s Sunday afternoon. What can I do?
sentences.zh: 周日午后。我能做点什么呢？

sentences.en: Annie 7 May
sentences.zh: 安妮 5 月 7 日

sentences.en: It’s Sunday afternoon. The last hours of the weekend before school starts again.
sentences.zh: 今天是周日下午。周末的最后几个小时，马上又要上学了。

sentences.en: This time is valuable, but I’m sitting here with nothing to do and no money to spend!
sentences.zh: 这段时间很宝贵，可我坐在这里，无事可做，也没钱可花！

sentences.en: So I need ideas for things to do.
sentences.zh: 所以我需要一些点子，找点事做。

sentences.en: Important: they need to be fun and free.
sentences.zh: 重要的是：要有意思，还不花钱。

sentences.en: I’m asking for help because time is running out!
sentences.zh: 我在求助，因为时间不多了！

sentences.en: Austin08 (Five minutes ago)
sentences.zh: Austin08（5 分钟前）

sentences.en: Go for a walk. I always go for a walk on Sunday. I like going on my own.
sentences.zh: 去散散步吧。我每周日都去散步。我喜欢一个人走。

sentences.en: It’s the perfect time to think about all the things I don’t normally have time to think about and I never think about things I need to do.
sentences.zh: 那是思考那些平时没时间想的事情的最佳时机，而我从不去想那些必须做的事。

sentences.en: I like forgetting all about them just for a few hours every week.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢每周有那么几个小时，把这些全都忘掉。

sentences.en: MonsterMunch4342 (20 minutes ago)
sentences.zh: MonsterMunch4342（20 分钟前）

sentences.en: I’m writing my weekly poetry blog post. Well, I was – now I’m writing to you.
sentences.zh: 我正在写我每周的诗歌博客。嗯，刚才在写——现在我在给你回信。

sentences.en: I upload a post every Sunday.
sentences.zh: 我每个周日都会发一篇博文。

sentences.en: At the moment, I’m finishing poem number 15. Five more to go!
sentences.zh: 现在我正在写第 15 首诗。还有 5 首就写完了！

sentences.en: Maybe you don’t want to write a poem or even a blog, so try a story.
sentences.zh: 也许你不想写诗，甚至不想写博客，那就试试写故事吧。

sentences.en: Go on – use your imagination!
sentences.zh: 来吧——发挥你的想象力！

sentences.en: Cool656Carl (25 minutes ago)
sentences.zh: Cool656Carl（25 分钟前）

sentences.en: I’m lucky. I live in Liverpool and we have the best museums and they’re all free.
sentences.zh: 我很幸运。我住在利物浦，这里有最棒的博物馆，而且都免费。

sentences.en: They’re too big for just one visit, so one Sunday every month I go and check out a different room.
sentences.zh: 它们太大了，一次看不完，所以我每个月挑一个周日，去看看不同的展厅。

sentences.en: Today it’s the insect room – I want to see what unusual bugs they have!
sentences.zh: 今天是昆虫展厅——我想看看那里有什么奇怪的虫子！

sentences.en: SillyMilly (32 minutes ago)
sentences.zh: SillyMilly（32 分钟前）

sentences.en: Read something. Sunday is my reading day.
sentences.zh: 读点东西吧。周日是我的阅读日。

sentences.en: I read for at least four hours on a Sunday – books, magazines, websites, newspapers – anything.
sentences.zh: 周日我至少读 4 个小时——书、杂志、网站、报纸——什么都读。

sentences.en: It’s free and best of all – you can do it anywhere.
sentences.zh: 这不用花钱，而且最重要的是——你在哪儿都能读。

sentences.en: And sometimes, when I’m really lucky, Dad brings me a drink, too.
sentences.zh: 有时候我特别走运，爸爸还会给我送一杯饮料来。
